subject: Orbitrex procurement - assurance pack onboarding & scope clarifications
messages:
From: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@orbitrex.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: James Coulter <j.coulter@orbitrex.com>, orbitrex-procurement@orbitrex.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up — initial assurance asks

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement/security at Orbitrex are moving this to the 2-week review bucket and we need an initial assurance package to share with our InfoSec panel. Specifically we need: a control mapping (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG) that shows which Redwood controls map to our critical controls, plus any representative artifacts (e.g., SOC2 assertion, KMS proof excerpt, network segmentation diagrams).

Can you confirm:
- Primary contact for evidence delivery and expected SSO/Drive access method
- Whether private deployments (VPC) are covered by the same KMS/backups we describe in the hosted docs or use a different model
- An ETA for an initial crosswalk and sample artifacts (we're hoping for something by Tuesday the 7th)

I've attached the Orbitrex_RFI_v1.pdf with our baseline questionnaire and the scoring rubric. If you prefer a short call tomorrow to align scope, say so and we'll schedule.

Best,
Samantha Lin
Head of Procurement — Orbitrex Systems
sam.lin@orbitrex.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachment: Orbitrex_RFI_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@orbitrex.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2029 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — initial assurance asks

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list and the RFI. We're glad Orbitrex is moving fast.

Short answers up front:
- Primary evidence lead: irene_choi@redwood.com (security/compliance).
- Private deployments: same control framework applies but operational proof differs slightly — for VPC/on-prem we provide customer-managed KMS integration notes and sample configuration snapshots rather than our hosted KMS receipts. We'll mark those explicitly in the crosswalk.
- ETA: we'll send an initial crosswalk and a small artifact packet by Tuesday 2029-05-07 EOD PT.

Next steps I propose:
1) We'll attach a preliminary control inventory (Redwood_Control_Inventory_v0.1.xlsx) showing our SOC2/ISO/SIG mappings to Redwood product features.
2) Internal owners will pick representative artifacts (SOC2 assertion, key rotation log excerpt, network diagram).
3) If you want an evidence walkthrough, we can book a 30-min slot Tuesday morning.

I've cc'd irene (security) to pick owners and jasmine (your account exec) to handle scheduling and HubSpot updates.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Control_Inventory_v0.1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 5 May 2029 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — initial assurance asks

Mateo / Jasmine — I pulled together a short task list and a skeleton crosswalk (crosswalk_skeleton.xlsx) for the artifacts we can share without legal review:

Task owners (initial):
- SOC2 assertion / audit letter: irene_choi (packaging & redaction)
- KMS proof excerpt (hosted): ops-evidence@redwood.com (redacted snapshot)
- VPC/KMS integration notes: infra-eng (technical note + config snippet)
- Network diagrams / segmentation: platform-arch@redwood.com
- Retention & deletion policy: legal@redwood.com (policy extract)

Notes:
- We'll mark any items that require customer NDA or redaction.
- For Orbitrex's procurement rubric, I'll flag 'representative artifacts' vs 'full logs' to minimize production risk.

I'll hand off the initial packet to Mateo Tuesday AM.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Attachment: crosswalk_skeleton.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@orbitrex.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, James Coulter <j.coulter@orbitrex.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Initial assurance packet and proposed evidence cadence

Hi Samantha / James — per our plan, attached is the initial packet we discussed:
- SOC2_assertion_summary.pdf (high-level assertion text and auditor name)
- Redwood_Control_Inventory_v0.1.xlsx (control map: SOC2 / ISO 27001 / SIG -> Redwood capabilities)
- crosswalk_skeleton.xlsx (artifact list with owners and redaction flags)

Public links and scheduling:
- Shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/Orbitrex/assurance-onboarding (contains the attachments above plus placeholder diagrams)
- Proposed evidence walkthrough: Wed 2029-05-08 09:00 PT (30 min). Jasmine, can you lock this if it works for Orbitrex?

A few clarifications inline from our internal assembly:
> From Samantha: "whether private deployments (VPC) are covered by the same KMS/backups we describe in the hosted docs or use a different model"

Answer: For hosted Redwood we operate an HSM-backed KMS with auditable rotation logs; for private/VPC we support customer-managed KMS (CloudKMS/HSM) integrations — we will provide a config snapshot and an example of a rotation log from a test environment where permitted. Where Orbitrex requires audit-grade logs for private instances, we can arrange a scoped attestation under an NDA.

Attachments: SOC2_assertion_summary.pdf, Redwood_Control_Inventory_v0.1.xlsx, crosswalk_skeleton.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0187

From: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@orbitrex.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: James Coulter <j.coulter@orbitrex.com>, orbitrex-procurement@orbitrex.com
Date: Wed, 8 May 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial assurance packet and proposed evidence cadence

Mateo — received, thank you. The packet looks good for initial review. We confirmed Wed 09:00 PT for the walkthrough; invite coming from our side. Two quick asks before the call:
- Can Irene include a one-paragraph redaction policy note (what types of fields we should expect redacted) so our legal team can pre-clear?
- If you have a short excerpt (2–3 lines) of a KMS rotation log for hosted (redacted IDs), that would be helpful to show auditors — if not, a statement of log retention and where it lives is fine.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Samantha
Samantha Lin
Head of Procurement — Orbitrex Systems
sam.lin@orbitrex.com
+1 415-555-0134
